record.name: AHMP Chicago Environmental Scholarship
record.sponsor: Alliance of Hazardous Materials Professionals - Chicago Chapter
record.summary: Two $2,000 awards for Illinois undergraduate juniors/seniors and graduate students in environmental fields at northern Illinois colleges.
other_eligibility: Undergraduate juniors or seniors, or graduate students (degree or certificate)
Attending a 4-year institution in northern Illinois (e.g. DePaul, UIC, IIT, NIU, North Central College, Northwestern, Elmhurst); SE Wisconsin and NW Indiana schools may be considered
Environmental-related degree or certificate program, including civil engineering or natural sciences with an environmental emphasis
Must not have previously won this scholarship
One award is for an undergraduate and one for a graduate student
Includes a one-year complimentary AHMP Chicago Chapter membership

essays.prompt: Why are you pursuing an environmental career, and which career areas interest you most? Describe your environmental work, volunteer and/or leadership experience and how it has prepared you. List honors, awards or previous (non-financial-need) scholarships. Two pages total for all answers.

record.name: HCAI Associate Degree Nursing Scholarship Program
record.sponsor: California Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI)
record.summary: Up to $8,000 for California students in an associate degree RN program who commit to one year of direct patient care in an underserved area.
other_eligibility: Accepted or enrolled in an accredited associate degree nursing program leading to RN licensure
Must begin class or training program by October 1, 2026 and graduate after March 31, 2027
Must commit to a one-year service obligation of at least 32 hours per week of direct patient care in an underserved area or qualifying facility in California, starting within six months of graduation
Must not hold another service obligation, including with other HCAI programs
Enrolled in at least six semester units until program completion
Awardees who do not complete the service obligation may have to repay the award
